name: Obsidian Atelier
promise: A night gallery of chapters: each work a room of its own, read in a narrow column beside its artifact.
description: A gallery composition. The opening and a quiet chapter index come first, then one chapter a work, the signature and the featured works in the owner's order: a full-bleed room for the artifact, a narrow analytical column for the premise, and the rest of the case behind Unfold the case. Each medium gets its own room, so a photograph, an interface, a system, and an essay don't share one card. Every chapter has a direct link and plain previous and next links, and nothing needs motion, hover, or JavaScript. Its dark values come from the selected color scheme, never from the composition.

sources.source: Page 93's photography-first rhythm and Page 98's editorial type hierarchy
sources.note: Full-bleed artifact rooms beside a narrow analytical column, one chapter a work, rebuilt on the v3 records, the kit's shared renderers, and #19's primitives.
Unfold the case: a closed native details holds each chapter's case below its premise and artifact.

sources.source: The dark experiments' black and gold, and their fixed dark theme
sources.note: Mineral dark and oxidized accents belong to the color schemes (#19, Codex [31]). The composition never forces dark.

sources.source: Page 99's typewriter roles, hover depth, and magnetic actions
sources.note: No tilt, hover, parallax, or chapter animation is needed to read or reach anything.
